items.name: Readability
items.evidence: One-line fix with a clear comment, '# Ensure base table is in the query', matching the existing style. The added test name test_fast_delete_all is descriptive. The only flaw is a stray trailing blank line at the end of tests.py.

items.name: Maintainability
items.evidence: Reuses the existing query.get_initial_alias() helper inside single_alias, matching the reference fix. Collector and QuerySet.delete are untouched, and there is no duplicated logic or debug leftover.

items.name: Robustness
items.evidence: Small change that adds no error handling or magic constants. get_initial_alias() is idempotent: it reuses the existing base alias if one exists. Hidden tests pass (P2P 52/52).

items.name: Subquery dropped only for genuine single-table deletes
items.name_zh: 仅在真正单表删除时去掉子查询
items.evidence: Root cause is fixed in single_alias by calling self.query.get_initial_alias() before counting aliases. Joined deletes still count more than one alias, so they keep the pk__in subquery, and the MySQL override that uses single_alias benefits. There is no special case for one backend.
